note: What the hash pool catches on a reused photo, measured in code on 9 photos from content/verify/fixtures, each put through 13 changes a reuser makes (saved again, resized, cropped, turned, brightened, screenshotted, mirrored): how many of the 117 copies the two thresholds catch against the source photo's stored hash, and how many copies come within those thresholds of a picture they are not a copy of (the other source photos, and every other recall's distinct published pictures). It measures these photos and these changes; recorded by scripts/public/hash-reuse-run.ts with no model call, no network and no database, and derived again by tests/hash-reuse-run.test.ts.
